answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 49023 Country: India Title: Is American cow’s milk halal or not? Question: Is American cow’s milk halal or not? Answer ID: 49023 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1428/1428/M=12/1434) If the American cow is just like normal cow in face and other characteristics, then its milk is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
